offering_description.value: Provides employment background screening, identity verification, drug and health screening, and related workforce risk and compliance services to employers. Delivered through a cloud-based technology platform that integrates with applicant tracking and HR systems.

primary_products.value: background screening platform; identity verification software; applicant onboarding and compliance software

primary_services.value: criminal record checks; employment and education verification; drug and health screening; identity verification; continuous monitoring and I-9 compliance

customer_segment.value: B2B: employers across industries, staffing firms, gig and platform companies, and HR technology providers

end_markets.value: staffing; healthcare; retail; transportation and logistics; financial services; gig economy

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: per-screen fees for background checks, verifications and screening packages; service fees: monitoring, compliance and onboarding services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: aggregates court, employer, education and other data sources and delivers screening reports to employers; software / platform: cloud platform integrated with HR and applicant tracking systems

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other markets, with screening in over 200 countries

specialization.value: related lines: background screening, identity verification, drug and health screening and compliance solutions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving enterprise and mid-market employers; partners / resellers: integrations with HR technology and applicant tracking providers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: consumer reporting subject to FCRA, FTC and CFPB oversight, state laws, and data privacy rules such as GDPR
